description: This file defines a report module for Odoo (OpenERP), specifically generating a workcenter load report with custom date computations and PDF rendering.

classes.name: external_pdf
classes.description: A class for rendering external PDF content, inherits from report.render.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: Main class for generating a custom workcenter load report with date computations and PDF output.

methods.name: _compute_dates
methods.description: Computes date ranges based on the specified time unit (month, week, day) between start and stop dates.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the report PDF based on database queries, date ranges, and chart plotting.

methods.name: _empty_graph
methods.description: Creates a placeholder graph when no data is available.
